product_name: Potato Annotation Tool - a lightweight, configurable annotation platform for NLP research.
Documentation Portal - an interactive guide for setting up and running annotation tasks.
Config Playground - a visual builder for creating annotation configurations.
Admin Dashboard - a management console for monitoring annotators and reviewing progress.
Export Toolkit - utilities for exporting annotation results to common data formats.
Crowdsourcing Integration - connectors for launching tasks on external annotation platforms.
Quality Control Suite - features for measuring inter-annotator agreement and catching errors.
AI Assistance Module - model-in-the-loop suggestions to speed up annotation.
